name: mobile calls and texts
label: Mobile calls and text
customer_names: calls and texts on my phone

modes.title: Calls not connecting
modes.symptom: outgoing calls ending as soon as they are dialled
customer_says: I can't make any calls. I dial, it beeps three times and drops straight back to the keypad.
Every call I try to make fails instantly. Texts seem to go, but calls won't connect.
My phone won't ring out. It says call failed the second I press the green button.
I've been trying to phone my daughter and it just cuts off before it even rings.

fixes: moving call traffic to the backup switching node

causes.cause: an incorrect number routing table loaded during maintenance
fixes: reloading the correct number routing table

causes.cause: a licence limit reached on the voice core
fixes: raising the licence limit on the voice core

workarounds: turn on Wi-Fi calling in the phone's settings
use the Meridian Talk app over Wi-Fi to place calls
aftercare: restart the phone if calls still fail
turn Wi-Fi calling off again if it is not normally used

modes.title: Text messages delayed
modes.symptom: text messages arriving hours late or not at all
customer_says: My texts aren't getting through. People say they've sent me messages and nothing has arrived.
Text messages are turning up really late. I got a security code long after I'd asked for it.
I can't send texts. They sit there saying sending and then fail with a red mark.
Messages to my family aren't being delivered, and I'm not getting theirs either.

causes.cause: a backlog in the message centre queue
fixes: draining the backlog in the message centre queue

causes.cause: a full disk on the text delivery server
fixes: clearing space on the text delivery server

causes.cause: a spam filter update that held back ordinary messages

workarounds: send urgent messages through an internet messaging app
ask for security codes by voice call instead of by text
aftercare: resend any text that still shows as failed
expect delayed messages to arrive in a burst over the next hour

modes.title: No signal
modes.symptom: handsets showing no service across several postcodes
customer_says: My phone says no service. It has been emergency calls only all over town.
I've lost all signal on my mobile. Not one bar, at home or at work.
There's no reception at all on my phone. My neighbour is with Meridian too and his is the same.
My mobile has no signal whatsoever. I've walked right down the street and it makes no difference.

causes.cause: a tripped circuit breaker at the main mast site
fixes: resetting the tripped circuit breaker at the mast site

causes.cause: a failed baseband unit on the area's main mast
vandalism to the feeder cables at a mast

workarounds: connect to any Wi-Fi network and use Wi-Fi calling
divert calls to a landline by dialling the divert code from another phone
aftercare: switch the phone off and on so it finds the mast again
cancel any call divert that was set up during the fault

modes.title: One-way audio
modes.symptom: calls connecting with sound in one direction only
customer_says: When I ring someone they can hear me, but I can't hear them at all.
Calls connect, but there's silence on my end. The other person says they're shouting hello.
People keep hanging up on me because they can't hear me, although I can hear them perfectly.
Half the conversation is missing on every call. It is silence on one side.

fixes: taking the faulty media gateway card out of service

causes.cause: a codec mismatch introduced by a voice platform patch
a firewall rule blocking audio packets in one direction
fixes: correcting the firewall rule that blocks audio packets

workarounds: turn off 4G calling so calls fall back to the older network
place important calls from a landline or over an internet calling app
aftercare: turn 4G calling back on for clearer sound
restart the phone if calls are still silent

wrong_customer_side: a call barring setting left switched on
a faulty microphone in the handset
an account suspended for a missed payment
a phone case blocking the antenna
wrong_provider_side: a planned upgrade of the masts in the area
a fault with another network that passes calls to ours
heavy call volumes after a local emergency
a solar storm disturbing radio signals
